message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm when the smoke alarm decided to join the party. Instead of panicking, I shot a quick message to the family group chat: "Hey everyone, just a little smoke—kitchen adventure over here, nothing big!" A flurry of replies came in with everyone chiming in about their own cooking mishaps. It reminded me how important it is to have an escape plan and know where everyone should go in case things ever got serious. Plus, it’s nice to know we’ve got each other’s backs, even in the kitchen! Have you ever had a funny cooking moment that turned a little chaotic?
